purpose: Seed denominator for a read-only exception-authority audit. Consumption proves that authority binds a live finding; it does not prove the exception remains necessary. Counts come from runtime/production readers; source-literal counts are diagnostic only.

authorityModel.ordinary: A line-scoped @orb-waive binds one exact authored carrier and reported position. A file-scoped @orb-waive-file binds one exact policy/position token anywhere in its file for otherwise unwaivable spans; it still fails over-broad and is not a blanket file suppression. Malformed, stale, unbound, wrong-authority, duplicate-target and over-broad markers alarm centrally.
authorityModel.reviewedGrant: One central row binds exactly one policyId/subject/operation finding and carries why plus endsWhen. Zero consumption is stale; more than one match is over-broad and licenses nothing.
authorityModel.foreignSuppression: Biome, ESLint and TypeScript suppression directives are foreign-tool data classified by the suppressions policy; they are not Orb waiver syntax.
authorityModel.lensMarkers: AST diagnostic markers such as @public, @view-server-only, @swallowed-ok, @typeonly-ok, @column-ok and @nearpair-ok remain lens-specific two-sided claims and are not central gate authority.
authorityModel.nativeConfigGrant: Biome, ESLint and dependency-cruiser configurations contain hand-authored native rule/path permissions. Dedicated liveness policies read the native configuration and tracked corpus; genuinely absent-by-construction cases are licensed through exact central reviewed grants.
authorityModel.retiredGateIgnore: @orb-gate-ignore is retired and inert. gate-ignore-inventory is hard/error and reports any live marker.

ordinaryWaivers.treeDriftCheck: The authoritative full artifact counted all TypeScript and declared resource carriers. Current git diff and cached diff contain zero added or removed @orb-waive/@orb-waive-file marker lines.

reviewedGrants.literalCountWarning: Literal object counting is incomplete: several partitions construct rows through mapped/generated values and the central barrel composes spreads. Import the runtime REVIEWED_GRANTS roster; do not use grep or object-literal counts as the denominator.

foreignSuppressions.method: Enumerate tracked plus untracked JS/TS-family authored files, excluding captured SillyTavern runtime, and call the production suppressionSites reader for every file. The selected suppressions gate then proved all 64 rule/scope classes granted with zero effective findings, alarms, tool errors or withholding.

interpretation: The ordinary-waiver total comes from the authoritative complete all-policy artifact and remains current because no marker line changed; a selected-policy run alone sees only the carriers acquired for that selection and is not a substitute denominator.
The reviewed-grant denominator is the imported runtime REVIEWED_GRANTS array. Literal object counting undercounts it by 57 rows and three policies.
A reviewed grant may govern many source occurrences because the grant identity is the policy's subject/operation finding, not necessarily a source coordinate.
The 564 foreign suppression occurrences collapse to 64 rule/scope findings and 64 central grants; occurrences and grants overlap and must not be summed as independent exceptions.
A successful authority run proves exact binding and liveness only. Continued necessity requires behavioral and architectural evidence.
No exception should be removed until the underlying finding is repaired or an existing healthy witness proves the marker is redundant.

nativeConfigurationPermissions.result: All three owners completed with zero violations, authority alarms, tool errors or withholding. Their nine central grants are already included in the 480-row reviewed-grant denominator; do not add them again.

retiredAuthority.result: gate-ignore-inventory completed as hard/error with zero violations and no withholding.
